privacyPolicy.title: Terms & Conditions
privacyPolicy.intro: Please read these Terms & Conditions and Privacy Notice (the "Terms") carefully. They form a legal agreement between you and NutriFlow ("we", "us", "the app") and explain the rules for using the app and how we collect and process your personal data, including data concerning your health.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of the Terms
sections.body: By creating an account or using NutriFlow you confirm that you have read, understood and agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the app.

sections.heading: 2. About the app; no medical advice
sections.body: NutriFlow is a nutrition-tracking and wellness tool. It provides calorie and nutrient estimates, recipes, meal plans, articles and AI-generated insights for general informational purposes only. The app is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. AI-generated analysis of lab results may contain errors. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional before changing your diet, starting an exercise programme, or making any health decision, especially if you are pregnant, have a medical condition, food allergies or take medication. Never disregard professional advice because of something you read in the app.

sections.heading: 3. Eligibility
sections.body: You must be at least 16 years old to use NutriFlow. If you are younger, you may use the app only with the verifiable consent of a parent or legal guardian, who accepts these Terms on your behalf.

sections.heading: 4. Your account
sections.body: You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you provide and for keeping your sign-in credentials secure. Notify us immediately of any unauthorised use of your account. You may sign in with Google or Apple; those services are governed by their own terms.

sections.heading: 5. Personal data we process
sections.body: Account data: email address and sign-in method. Profile data: name, profile photo, sex, age, height, weight, target weight, activity level, goal, dietary preferences and allergies. Health-related data (special category data): weight history, BMI, calorie and nutrient intake, water intake, step count, allergies and dietary restrictions, and lab results and reports you choose to upload for analysis. Usage and preference data: recipes you view or favourite, meal plans, read articles, language, theme and notification settings.

sections.heading: 6. Your consent to the processing of personal and health data
sections.body: By ticking, accepting or continuing to use the app you give your free, specific, informed and explicit consent to the collection, storage and processing of your personal data, including data concerning your health, as described in these Terms. This includes your consent to (a) storing this data on your device and on our servers and those of our service providers; (b) using it to calculate your targets, personalise recommendations and track your progress; and (c) sending lab results you upload to a third-party AI service solely to generate the analysis you request. Consent is voluntary. Without it, features that require health data cannot be provided. You may withdraw your consent at any time as described in section 12.

sections.heading: 7. Purposes and legal basis
sections.body: We process your data to: create and manage your account and provide the app (performance of a contract); calculate nutrition targets, personalise content and generate AI insights, which involves health data (your explicit consent); keep the app secure, prevent abuse and fix errors (our legitimate interests); and comply with legal obligations. We do not use your health data for advertising.

sections.heading: 8. Storage, AI processing and service providers
sections.body: Data may be stored on your device and on secure servers operated by us or our hosting providers. Sign-in is provided by Google and Apple. Lab results you upload are sent to a third-party AI provider only to produce the analysis you request; we ask such providers to process the data only on our instructions. Where data is transferred outside your country or the EEA, we rely on appropriate safeguards such as standard contractual clauses.

sections.heading: 9. Data sharing
sections.body: We do not sell your personal data and we do not share your health data with advertisers. We disclose data only to service providers acting on our behalf as described above, or where required by law or to protect legal rights.

sections.heading: 10. Retention and deletion
sections.body: We keep your data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the app. You may delete data or ask us to delete your account at any time. After deletion we remove or anonymise your data within a reasonable period, except where the law requires us to retain it.

sections.heading: 11. Your rights
sections.body: Depending on where you live (for example under the GDPR) you have the right to access your data, correct it, delete it, restrict or object to its processing, receive it in a portable format, and lodge a complaint with your data protection authority. To exercise these rights, contact us using the details in section 17.

sections.heading: 12. Withdrawing consent
sections.body: You may withdraw your consent at any time by deleting the relevant data in the app, stopping use of the app, or emailing us. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before it. After withdrawal we will stop processing your health data and, on request, delete it, but some features may no longer be available.

sections.heading: 13. Security
sections.body: We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your data. No system is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security. You are responsible for protecting your device and account.

sections.heading: 14. Acceptable use and intellectual property
sections.body: You agree not to misuse the app, attempt to gain unauthorised access, reverse engineer it, or use it unlawfully. The app, its design, text, recipes and other content are owned by us or our licensors and are protected by law. We grant you a limited, personal, non-transferable licence to use the app. Content you add remains yours, and you grant us the rights needed to store and display it to provide the service.

sections.heading: 15. Disclaimer and limitation of liability
sections.body: The app is provided "as is" and "as available". To the extent permitted by law, we do not guarantee that nutrition information, recipes or AI analysis are complete, accurate or suitable for you, and we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss or for any health outcome resulting from reliance on the app. Nothing in these Terms excludes liability that cannot be excluded by law or limits your mandatory consumer rights.

sections.heading: 16. Changes to these Terms
sections.body: We may update these Terms from time to time. We will update the "last updated" date and, where changes are material or affect your consent, ask you to review or renew it. Continued use after changes means you accept the updated Terms.

sections.heading: 17. Governing law and contact
sections.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the country in which the app operator is established, without prejudice to mandatory consumer protection rules of your country of residence. For questions, data requests or to withdraw consent, contact us at 5507151kr@gmail.com or via Help & Support in the app.
